R254.note: Service-level @PreAuthorize delegating to an ownership bean is the right Spring shape; relies on #orderId parameter-name resolution (-parameters flag, Boot's default) and a missing order now yields 403 instead of NoSuchElementException, both acceptable for the gate.

R255.note: GraalVM Context.create('js') with default (no host access) sandboxing closes the host-escape vector, but result.asBoolean() throws ClassCastException for a non-boolean rule result where the original returned false via Boolean.TRUE.equals, an unstated change that escapes the declared ScriptException contract.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argument array removes the shell; sourcePath is prefixed by UPLOAD_DIR so it cannot start with '-', and geometry sits in -resize's value slot, so option injection is not open either.

R257.note: Swaps findAll() for the existing findByOwnerUsername(authentication.getName()), matching the detail endpoint and the stated contract exactly.

R258.note: Moving username into a slog.String attribute gets strconv-style quoting of control characters under the default and Text handlers, so CRLF cannot forge a line; the resulting log-format change (level, key=value) is stated and blocks nothing.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting RestoredSession with !* closes arbitrary instantiation while keeping the wire format; the java.lang.String and '[L*;' entries are no-ops (strings are never filtered, and that array pattern is a literal that matches nothing) but harmless.

R260.note: Parameterized SqlCommand fed to SqlDataAdapter with an NVarChar @Region parameter; DataTable name and columns are unchanged and Fill still opens/closes the connection.

R261.note: Ownership check before deleteById closes the vector, but returning 403 for a non-owned document and 404 for a missing one distinguishes existence, contrary to the contract's 'should not reveal more than the existing not-found path'; getOwner().equals also NPEs on a null owner.

R262.note: Tika byte-based detection on a .tmp temp file closes the extension-spoof vector, but the added ImageIO re-encode is lossy, strips metadata, throws on legitimate CMYK/unsupported JPEGs (500 instead of stored upload) and ignores ImageIO.write's boolean, and the stored name gains an extension the original omitted.

R263.note: Sequelize bind parameters with $1/$2 placeholders send the dates out of band; the 400 guard and result shape are unchanged.

R264.note: Hand-built RESP multibulk with byte-length prefixes makes each argument atomic regardless of spaces or CRLF; UTF-8 encode/decode round-trip keeps the lengths consistent and HSET's reply is unchanged.

R265.note: Adds length > receivedByteCount - 2 before memmove, with the subtraction guarded by the existing receivedByteCount < 2 check; nothing else changes.

R266.note: Dropping cmd.exe for a ProcessBuilder argument list closes the injection, but the added host allowlist [a-zA-Z0-9.-]+ rejects IPv6 literals the original accepted for a customer-reported host, a stated but contract-narrowing restriction.

R267.note: Changing the field to string and dropping the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping for {{.Body}}.

R268.note: isabs rejection plus normpath containment against BASE_DIR + os.sep closes both the absolute-path join bypass and dot-dot traversal while leaving legitimate relative names untouched (symlinks inside BASE_DIR are out of scope and pre-existing).
